newsitem.title: USA: Affinity to buy 74 pct of Century Tech.
newsitem.headline: Affinity to buy 74 pct of Century Tech.

text.p: Affinity Entertainment Inc said Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to complete its purchase of a majority interest in Century Technologies Inc.
Under the terms of the agreement, Affinity has purchased 37,500,000 units from Century for $3 million in cash and notes, a statement from Affinity said.
Each unit consists of one share of Century common stock and one warrant to purchase an additional share of Century common stock at $2.00.
Under the agreement, Affinity will control about a 74 percent interest in Century, the statement said.

Affinity said the units may be separated immediately. The company also said it intends to issue a dividend to each Affinity shareholder of record at a date to be determined, of one Century unit for each common share of Affinity.
Affinity said the deal will allow it to implement its business plan, which is to become heavily vested in the U.S. and foreign distribution of both feature films and television programming.
